channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: U.S. debt interest payments reach $3 billion a day, up 8% in fiscal 2026
item.description: Net interest payments rose 8% to $1.05 trillion in fiscal 2026, while revenue increased 3% to $5.4 trillion and spending grew 6% to $7.4 trillion...

item.title: States sue OpenAI, alleging it enables cyberhacking agents and harms children
item.description: OpenAI said it has built safety protections into ChatGPT for children and would continue to do so to improve the model.

item.title: Alberta, holding world's fourth-largest oil reserves, to vote on first step to leaving Canada
item.description: The 2022 Freedom Convoy began over vaccine requirements for cross-border truckers but grew into a broader revolt against pandemic restrictions.

item.title: Economist: Iran war costs average U.S. household nearly $2,000, energy up $50 weekly
item.description: The total includes $1,100 in higher energy prices, $540 in higher interest rates and $360 in military costs.
